author: Zander Claassen
title: Microsoft Dynamics Developer
text: Shaun is a very talented and passionate developer. He shares his knowledge and journey with other young developers on his programming tutorials with Delphi. He is the true definition of a techie.

author: Walter Heymans
title: Senior AI Engineer
text: Shaun is a highly motivated software developer. He strives to achieve excellence in all the projects he attemps. He is very determined and hard working.

author: Adriaan Louw
title: Software Engineer
text: Shaun is a dedicated coder, while always thinking outside the box.

author: Ruan du Plessis
title: Operations Engineer (Electronic, Hydraulic, Mechanical and Mobile Control Systems)
text: Shaun is what people would call your "typical" developer. Likes late night coding, long enduring hours and amazing results. Definitely one of the hardest workers that I had the pleasure to meet.

author: Kelly Ralph Maruva
title: Dart - Flutter, Python, Node js, React|Next Js
text: Shaun is a very brilliant developer. Really really passionate about programming (He's been teaching programming for over 4 years on youtube!). He's the best young developer I know with lots of experience and that's why I would recommend him.

author: Gorhin Stroebel
title: Private Cloud Engineer
text: On a personal and professional level a great individual with amazing passions and dedication to his craft, a clean coder (obsessively so) and  always willing to help to teach others. One of the most influential people in my life personally and a real team player. To anyone who gets to work with Shaun, personally i think they are a very lucky to have such a helpful and dedicated Developer.

author: Hanli Marais
title: Senior Graphic Designer
text: I can absolutely recommend Shaun for his superb programming skills and experience. Great to work with.
